title: EVE wallet journal entry
description: Shape of one entry as returned by src/tools/character-tools.mjs's get_wallet_journal (record type EveWalletJournalEntry, wraps one raw ESI /characters/{id}/wallet/journal/ row). This schema describes the record's `data`, not the enclosing envelope.

id.description: CCP-issued stable journal entry id; the dedup key for ledger export.

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp as returned by ESI.

amount.description: Signed ISK delta: positive received, negative spent.

refTypeLabel.description: humanizeRefType(refType) output, e.g. "Bounty Prizes"; never null (falls back to "Unknown").
